title: Thin the X braces on the sliding doors
where: front (north) doors, leaves x3..6 and x8..11, y1..4, plane z=3 (and back z=19)
instruction: In build.mjs gableEnd(), the X is 8 white cells on 16 so the doors read as a white/red checker. Keep the white X on only the two long diagonals but make the leaf base 'red_terracotta' (not red_nether_bricks) and add a 1-block dark_oak_log bottom rail at y1 and top rail at y4 on each leaf; re-render the glance tile and keep whichever version reads as 'red doors with a white X'. Run mcd diff --fail-empty.

title: Side-wall dormers like the concept
where: both long roof slopes, lower pitch, z5..17
instruction: roof() takes only one dormer face per call. Re-roof with mcd roof build.nbt out.nbt --preset granary --style gambrel --ridge-axis z --dormers east:3 (the spec file route if the flag is missing), width 3 height 2, window = gray_stained_glass_pane, wall red_terracotta, white trim; then mirror the result to the west slope with mirrorX in build.mjs. Check the dormers do not tunnel the roof (mcd check).

title: Eave brackets under the long eaves
where: east and west eave, y5, every 4th cell z4..18
instruction: Add dark_oak_stairs upside-down (B.stairs('dark_oak', 'west'|'east', 'top')) one block out from the eave board at y4 under each bay post (z6, z10, z14, z18). Needs grid growth of 1 on x (g.resize([17,18,21],[1,0,0]) and shift all coordinates), or use mcd paint 'west top row -> brackets dark_oak at pilasters'.

title: Loft door shutters with X and a hay pulley
where: north gable, loft door x5..9, y6..9
instruction: Replace the open pale_oak_trapdoor shutters by white-framed shutters: keep trapdoors but add white smooth_quartz_stairs facing outward at (6,9,1) and (8,9,1) as a hood, and add a chain+lantern hanging inside the opening at (7,8,3) so the loft glows. Edit the loft block in gableEnd() in build.mjs.

title: Weather-vane arrow and rooster
instruction: The vane is a bars cross at y16. Make it an arrow along z: iron_bars at (7,16,9..13) plus a 3-high iron_bars cross-piece one block under it at (6..8,15,11), and put a lightning_rod at (7,17,11). If the build gets taller than 17, leave out the rod. Edit the vane lines at the end of the cupola section.

title: Weathering and mossy foundation
where: foundation ring y1 all four sides, and the roof slope
instruction: Run mcd paint build.nbt out.nbt --rules rules.txt --face north,east,south,west with: 'all faces ground row -> weather light' and 'all faces where stone_bricks -> vary subtle'. Do NOT weather the red terracotta (no family variants). Keep only if mcd diff --fail-empty passes and the render shows no speckle.

title: Barn sign / date plaque above the loft
where: north gable, wall cell (7,10,2) is the hoist beam: use the red field at x4..5 and x9..10, y8..9, z2 on the north face
instruction: B.sign('spruce', ['EST.', '1924'], {facing:'north', color:'white'}) at (4,8,1)->wall behind at (4,8,2); mirror a second wall sign 'RED', 'BARN' at (10,8,1)... If the signs look tiny, skip them and use B.banner('red',[['border','white']],{facing:'north'}) at (4,8,1) and (10,8,1) instead.

title: More farmyard props
where: yard z0..1 and east side x13..14 near the man-door
instruction: Add a wooden water trough (oak_trapdoor open around a water cauldron or 'water_cauldron') at (12,1,0); a hay bale stack of 3 at the east door (x14 side is the grid edge so put it at (13,1,9)); a lantern on a fence post (B.fence + B.lantern(false)) at (3,2,0) and (11,2,0); a few 'wheat' / 'short_grass' tufts at z0 on the grass; carts are out of scope.

title: Gate in the front fence
instruction: The fence has a 7-wide opening at the gravel path; close it with two oak_fence_gate blocks (facing north, one open) at (4,1,0) and (10,1,0) hinged toward the posts, leaving x5..9 open, or just place a single gate pair at x6/x8. Edit the yard section; check with mcd check that nothing floats.

title: Interior: hay and stalls so the doors read open
instruction: Add a loft floor of spruce_planks slabs at y5 (x2..12, z3..8), two rows of oak_fence stall dividers at x4 and x10 along z8..18, hay_block piles in the back corners, and 4 hanging lanterns (B.lantern(true)) on chains under the loft. Interior is invisible from outside except through the door gap and windows, so keep it cheap.
